3_ocrFoodInput.description: Extract text from receipts/labels, parse food items, add to inventory

ocrEngine.recommendation: Start with Tesseract, fallback to Google Vision if needed

workflow: 1. User uploads image (from Part 1 image upload feature)
2. Laravel sends image to Python AI service
3. Python runs OCR to extract text
4. Python parses text to identify food items, quantities, dates
6. Laravel presents data to user for confirmation

parsing.approach: Regex patterns + LLM fallback for ambiguous text
patterns: Item names: Look for common food keywords
Quantities: Match numbers followed by units (kg, g, L, ml, pcs)
Dates: Match date formats (DD/MM/YYYY, MM-DD-YYYY, etc.)
Prices: Match currency symbols with numbers
parsing.llmEnhancement: If regex fails, send OCR text to LLM: 'Extract food items with quantities from: {text}. Return JSON: [{item, quantity, unit}]'

4_expirationRiskPrediction.description: Predict which items will expire soon, prioritize consumption

dataInput: Item category and typical_expiration_days from food_items
Seasonality data (dummy: summer = faster expiry for fresh items)

factors: consumptionFrequency: If user rarely consumes this category, higher risk
quantity: Large quantities harder to consume in time
seasonality: Fresh items in warm weather expire faster (dummy rule)
riskScoring.formula: riskScore = (100 - daysUntilExpiry*5) + (30 if lowConsumptionFreq) + (10 if largeQuantity) + (15 if warmSeason && freshCategory)

steps: 1. Calculate risk score for each inventory item

consumptionAnalyzer.pseudocode:
def analyze_patterns(user_id, days_back):
    # Fetch data from Laravel API
    logs = fetch_consumption_logs(user_id, days_back)
    inventory = fetch_inventory(user_id)
    
    # Process with pandas
    df = pd.DataFrame(logs)
    df['day_of_week'] = pd.to_datetime(df['consumption_date']).dt.day_name()
    
    # Generate heatmap data
    heatmap = df.groupby(['day_of_week', 'category'])['quantity'].sum().to_dict()
    
    # Detect patterns
    over_consumption = detect_over_consumption(df)
    under_consumption = detect_under_consumption(df)
    waste_risks = predict_waste_risks(inventory, df)
    
    return {
        'weeklyTrends': heatmap,
        'overConsumption': over_consumption,
        'underConsumption': under_consumption,
        'wasteRiskItems': waste_risks
    }
keyFunctions: fetch_consumption_logs(): HTTP GET to Laravel API
predict_waste_risks(): Match inventory items with low consumption frequency

mealOptimizer.pseudocode:
def optimize_meal_plan(user_id, week_start, preferences):
    # Fetch user data
    inventory = fetch_inventory(user_id)
    budget = fetch_user_budget(user_id)
    
    # Prioritize inventory items by expiry
    sorted_items = sort_by_expiry(inventory)
    
    # Create base meals using inventory
    base_meals = create_meals_from_inventory(sorted_items)
    
    # Calculate remaining budget
    remaining_budget = budget - sum([item['cost'] for item in base_meals])
    
    # Use LLM to suggest additional meals
    llm_meals = generate_meals_with_llm(remaining_budget, preferences)
    
    # Combine and validate
    full_plan = base_meals + llm_meals
    shopping_list = generate_shopping_list(full_plan, inventory)
    
    return {
        'mealPlan': full_plan,
        'shoppingList': shopping_list,
        'totalCost': calculate_total_cost(shopping_list)
    }

ocrService.preprocessing:
def preprocess_image(image):
    # Convert to grayscale
    grayscale = image.convert('L')
    # Apply threshold
    threshold = grayscale.point(lambda x: 0 if x < 128 else 255)
    return threshold
